scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 workable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 9 excellent with minor issues; 10 exceptional across assessed experience. Subjective judgments of observed content, not win/loss grades or physical-device certification.

reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent atmospheric mission with helpful feedback and accessible objective completion; manual combat and small distant targets introduce uncertainty and friction.
reasons.controls: Large separated touch buttons, tap aim and MOVE/FIRE simultaneous input worked at entry. Patrol drag/movement lost target visibility; automatic releases prevent continuous burst comfort assessment.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, coil shutdown and uplink provide distinct tasks with clear progress. Assisted traversal dominated and manual patrol engagements lacked clear immediate confirmations; independent combat depth and sustained enjoyment remain unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Rain, industrial silhouettes, teal/orange lighting and consistent typography create a strong visual identity. Software WebGL images only; audio and hardware smoothness unassessed.
reasons.usability: Contextual HOLD ROUTE/APPROACH/RECOVER, map, OFF labels, upload percent and START FRESH made progression and restart clear.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and key prompts readable at 844x390; distant patrols and environmental text small; dark structure and pillars can obscure targets.

scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed but playable with substantial friction; 7 good with meaningful limitations; 10 exceptional across assessed content. Subjective observed-use ratings, not certification or a win/loss grade.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent and completable portrait mission with clear recovery/extraction feedback and attractive consistent art. Combat tracking and dense small HUD cues limit confidence; assists did much of navigation.
reasons.controls: Two-contact MOVE plus FIRE drag and scene turning visibly work. Tap aim and large anchored controls help. Charging patrol tracking was uncertain in both attempts; continuous burst rearming and physical thumb comfort are unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Three recoveries, coil exposure phases and uplink form a readable mission arc. Offscreen charging patrols made combat hard to interpret. Route-assisted completion alone gives limited evidence of independent navigation or sustained combat enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Strong teal/amber industrial rain atmosphere, coherent gun/world/menu styling and a polished result card in the viewed scenes. No audio assessment.
reasons.usability: Contextual hold labels, route guidance, explicit fresh start and assist stats help. Some assisted turns briefly leave a wall-facing view; manual pursuit requires more correction.
reasons.readability: Large health/ammo and high-contrast contextual labels are useful; small distant enemies, fine spaced type, top banners and threat cues compete in 390px width.
